summary: Gossamer Bio filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing submission of its first New Drug Application to the FDA in September 2026 for seralutinib in pulmonary arterial hypertension. The NDA rests on the Phase 3 PROSERA trial as one adequate and well-controlled investigation, supported by Phase 2 TORREY data and analyses. Following a June 2026 Pre-NDA Type B meeting, FDA minutes framed PROSERA's statistical significance and effect magnitude as review, not filing, issues. FDA filing acceptance is expected later this year; no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendation are stated.
